scenes.audio_transcript:
Character B says: मला काल रात्री नीट झोप लागली नाही. [I didn't sleep well last night.]
Character A says: I did not sleep well last night.
Character B says: मी वारंवार उठत होते. [I was waking up repeatedly.]
Character A says: I kept waking up again and again.
Character B says: माझं मन शांत नव्हतं. [My mind was not calm.]
Character A says: My mind was not calm.
Character B says: आज मला खूप थकवा जाणवतो आहे. [I am feeling very tired today.]
Character A says: I feel very tired today.
Character B says: मला लक्ष केंद्रित करता येत नाहीये. [I am not able to concentrate.]
Character A says: I am not able to focus.
Character B says: आज सगळंच हळूहळू चालल्यासारखं वाटतंय. [Today everything feels like it's moving slowly.]
Character A says: Everything feels slow today.
Character B says: विनाकारण चिडचिड होत आहे. [I am getting irritated for no reason.]
Character A says: I am feeling irritated for no reason.
Character B says: अगदी छोटी कामंसुद्धा कठीण वाटत आहेत. [Even small tasks feel difficult.]
Character A says: Even small tasks feel difficult.
Character B says: काश, काल नीट झोप झाली असती. [I wish I had slept well yesterday.]
Character A says: I wish I had slept better.
Character B says: आजचा दिवस नेहमीपेक्षा जास्त लांब वाटतोय. [Today feels longer than usual.]
Character A says: Today feels longer than usual.
Character B says: प्रत्येक वाक्याचं तू इंग्लिश मध्ये लगेच उत्तर दिलंस. कुठून शिकलास? [You answered every sentence immediately in English. Where did you learn from?]
Character A says: मी रोज पंधरा मिनिटं एआय सोबत बोललो आणि तिथूनच शिकलो. [I spoke with an AI for fifteen minutes every day and learned from there.]
Character B says: कसं? आणि कोणतं एआय? [How? And which AI?]
Character A says: MySivi AI. यात एआय सोबत बोलताना ती तुला इंग्लिश बोलायला लावते आणि चूक झाली तर लगेच करेक्ट करते. [MySivi AI. In this, while talking to the AI, it makes you speak English and if you make a mistake, it corrects it immediately.]
Character B says: आणि पैसे किती? [And how much does it cost?]
Character A says: फक्त एक रुपयात सुरू करू शकतेस. [You can start for just one rupee.]
Character B says: ट्राय करते MySivi ॲप. [I'll try the MySivi app.]
